# HWHDRSupported

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWHDRSupported:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if HDR output works, else 0.

## Description

A BlitzLLVM extension: tells whether [SetGraphicsHDR](SetGraphicsHDR) can show a window in HDR here. It is 1 if the display of the window (or the primary display, if there is no window yet) has HDR switched on, and once there is a window also if the driver offers an HDR swapchain for it. It is looked at every time, as HDR can be switched on and off while the program runs, and the window can be moved to another display. Where this is 0, asking for HDR does nothing.
